         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      2 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 9 jun 2026 - 17 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _sianadele_, 17 ago 2026, 1/5: "Downloaded this because I’ve seen so many people talking about it. It started off well but not every time I open the app it freezes and I can’t click anything!"
            2. _Rxxhxm_, 9 jun 2026, 1/5: "I am a long term user. I have been using it everyday since January 2021. I have even bought the premium version of the app. This app has really helped me with my life. I highly recommend this app to anyone wanting a track their habits. However, I would not recommend this app to use long-term as if you want to track your progress, you can’t as I have explained below. I initially reviewed and rated it 5*. The reason why I am rating it 1* is because, as time went by, the habit tracking became more and more broken, unstable, unusable meaning that if you go on any specific habit, then you scroll down to ‘trending’ or ‘comparison’ between weeks, months and years. It doesn’t show last weeks or this weeks / last month or this month / last year or this years progress. Instead, it’s just a blank black screen. This has been like this for 6-9 months and I thought that I would give the developers the opportunities to fix this issue however they did not fix the issue but instead of pushing out new features and updates rather than fixing the original issue. This is unfair for the people who has paid for the premium service, but isn’t getting the basic features of the app."
            3. _Girly1224_, 4 ago 2026, 5/5: "Same issue here app keeps crashing and I have the paid version would really like it if I am updated about this current issue. I actually really like the app but this issue needs to be updated. Ill come back and give it a better review once its fixed."
<!--/ir-theme-->
